release_notes:
v2.1.3 — Public Distribution Release

New features:
- Sale-level (cart-wide) discount with Apply/Edit/Remove dialog
- Compact POS cart footer with sale discount preserved
- 4-column 88px product grid (auto-responsive)
- Cost price shown on product cards
- Compact customer selector widget

Fixes:
- Sales History performance: single JOIN query, pagination, SQL indexes
- Sale Details RenderFlex overflow fixed
- Cart header and item price encoding bugs fixed
- POS product card subtle green tint

Analytics:
- Financial Summary card restored on P&L Overview tab

Distribution:
- Release assets moved to public AskanPharma-Releases repository
- Auto-updater now points to public manifest URL
